university-of-al-qarawiyyin-founded: Founded in Fez by Fatima al-Fihri; often called the oldest university still operating.
vikings-at-lanse-aux-meadows: Norse sailors from Greenland build a camp in Newfoundland, nearly 500 years before Columbus.
louisiana-purchase: The US buys about 2.1 million km² from Napoleon's France for $15 million, doubling its size.
invasion-of-russia: Napoleon's Grande Armée of about 600,000 men marches into Russia; fewer than 100,000 make it back.
hunger-winter: A German blockade and a harsh winter cause a famine in the occupied west; about 20,000 people die.
